intro.heading: Your Trusted Sourcing Partner in Indian Textile Hubs
intro.leadParagraph: Shree Durga Agency is a textile sourcing and consulting partner helping retailers, wholesalers, boutiques and other textile businesses source products from relevant textile markets and production centres.
intro.secondaryParagraph: Navigating diverse textile hubs requires local market knowledge, trusted supplier networks, and careful quality verification. We work closely with buyers to identify reputable manufacturers, verify fabric hand-feel and embellishment standards, and coordinate seamless bulk dispatches.
intro.quote: Our mission is to make wholesale textile sourcing transparent, reliable, and hassle-free for retail and trade businesses across India.

items.quote: Shree Durga Agency transformed our seasonal bridal procurement. Instead of spending weeks navigating unverified brokers in congested markets, we receive curated swatches with guaranteed mill-direct pricing and strict QA before dispatch.
items.author: Vikram Singhania

items.quote: ThreadLinc Financing combined with Shree Durga Agency's direct Surat polyester and georgette manufacturer connections allowed our wholesale business to scale inventory 40% ahead of Diwali season with absolute liquidity ease.
items.author: Harish Patel

items.quote: Finding authentic chanderi, tussar silk, and hand-block artisans used to be hit-or-miss. With Shree Durga Agency's artisan cluster linkage, our boutique has established direct provenance with master weavers at fair market rates.
items.author: Ananya Sen

items.quote: Their on-the-ground inspection team in Surat and Varanasi catches shade variances and weave flaws before lots are packed. That level of operational rigor and transparent invoicing is rare in Indian textile trade.
items.author: R. Sundaram

items.quote: We source over 3,000 meters of unstitched salwar suit fabrics every quarter. Shree Durga Agency coordinates sampling, mill price lock-in, and consolidated transport directly to our wholesale hub in Delhi.
items.author: Gaurav Malhotra

items.quote: For our high-ticket lehenga collection, we needed dependable zari embroidery suppliers who deliver on agreed delivery calendars. Shree Durga Agency has been an indispensable partner for our bridal flagship.
items.author: Meenakshi Kothari
